lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song to the LORD because He has done wonders.
His own right hand and holy arm gained Him the victory, and He revealed His righteousness to the nations.
He remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Judah, and the ends of the earth saw His salvation.
All the earth is called to praise Him with the lyre, the harp, and flutes and pipes.
The sea, the rivers and the mountains are called to rejoice because He comes to judge the earth with equity.
